summary: Wading in the lily pond works for the player and a traced water fight film shows friends in the pond; my own sandbox screenshots show the resting pond looks fine and the island is lively at midday. I did not trigger a splash or a kite flight myself.
surprise_why: A player can finally walk into the pond and splash, and friends hold a water fight, but it is a small pond toy rather than a new kind of thing.

findings.what: Water fight film: after the first 3 s the splashes are barely visible; frames 5-11 show friends standing in dark pond water, and a blue creature's head fills the lower right for several seconds. It reads as people standing in a pond, not a fight.
findings.suggestion: Keep a camera where thrown scoops and hit reactions show, cut on each throw, and keep the foreground clear.
findings.agent_notes: Fair. The water fight film stays as posted; the s88 film (the mix-up) frames the ring round Lumi from the clearest of eight sides chosen once, and goes closer only while something happens.

findings.what: Ripples and splashes are hard to read: in the author's wading screenshot the rings are thin white lines on flat slate water and the splash drops look like white balls. My own resting-pond screenshot (reviews/r87-b.png) shows a calm flat blue disc, so ripples only exist while something moves in it.
findings.suggestion: Wider soft-faded rings in a brighter tint, smaller translucent droplets.
findings.agent_notes: Fair: ripples only exist while something moves in the pond, by design (a still pond is still). They are brighter since s86 (alpha 0.85) and fade before the bank since s87; the drops are plain white spheres, which I have not changed.

findings.what: The nap and kite camera fixes were verified only on short runs (about 8 sim minutes for naps, one kite flight, one 0.99 obstruction sample). My midday sandbox sample (12:16, boing event running) had 1 asleep, consistent with the rule, but that is one sample.
findings.suggestion: Add tests that sample the nap count over a full 10:00-16:00 window and the kite camera with the 9-of-10 obstruction rule.
findings.agent_notes: Fair: short runs. The nap rule now checks twice a second (s87) and held in every sample since; the kite check was one flight of ten samples.
